decision_blockers: PairFold pair-local pre is not measured in the released runtime; the 8.191305 ms recurrent term and attention chunks are transferred from four-GPU HeadFold.

limitations: Absolute wall is calibrated to the supplied PairFold R0 profile.
Weight copies use the pessimistic measured fragmented bandwidth.
The greedy test-informed oracle is not manifest-emittable.
Late helper launches remain in the resource schedule even when the owner uses canonical fallback.
PairFold is absent from the released runtime and its pair-local pre timing is an optimistic, unmeasured transfer.
The modeled N512 arena is not the released aw_pair_scratch allocation, so the production memory floor is unresolved.
